Candidate: Per case: 32 V10 cases use candidate.json; eight V11 cases use candidate-badges.json. The final delta changes badge brushes only; badge-visual.json covers both light themes at all five display pairs on the final candidate.
Method: Physical VMware display resolution and GetDpiForWindow measurements; seven pages restored and maximized; keyboard focus/Tab/Shift+Tab and visibility for Scan Installed, Install Selected, Preview and Execution History; actual process restart, theme round trip and contrast/reduced-motion toggle persistence. Page markers require nonempty bounds intersecting the window. Screenshots are retained for every case; representative images are inspected separately.
IntermediateRuns: The V10 150% group was invalidated by a measured mid-group VMware resolution change to 1552x1123; all eight cases are repeated in V11 with per-page and final display checks. V2-V9 are intermediate, not this final verdict. Dashboard markers can incorrectly report IsOffscreen=true despite visible coordinates and captures. Independent UIA observations document this discrepancy. V10 retains the flag as evidence, uses actual marker bounds and page-specific actions, and keeps critical-control geometry and keyboard gates.
